findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed manifest writes baseline_suite and after_suite as prose rather than the contract's JSON object naming a log_path, so annotate_review_of_run cannot resolve the arm logs and a read of the record yields added_failure_count null (unmeasured) although test_logs names both logs.

follow-on: _discard_run_store_row issues raw DELETE statements against run_store's runs and run_details tables because run_store exposes no public removal API, so a schema change in that module silently breaks the row removal this guard relies on.
follow-on: the plan's section 39 text still carries the plan-file clause the coordinator's ruling withdrew, so the plan and the landed design disagree; only the plan owner may correct it.

follow-on: no gate log in the reviewed evidence names the reviewed head b32e2df — the arm ran at the code commit 1b68a6b79 — so the full head arm's coverage of the final reviewed revision rests on the reviewer's own re-run of the guard file, not on the recorded arm.
